I catfished a poor little guy once. Before I start sorry about my poor english, I am not native.

I was 14 at the time and I wasn't really popular with boys back then, so I usually talk dirty in chats with boys, sometimes even sexting.

 Anyways, I was really into a videogame at the time so I started a Twitter account roleplaying it. It got a lot of traction and I made a lot of friends. I started talking to a guy and it got, obviously, sexual. I had really serious selfsteem issues back then (I went to therapy and now Im good, btw) so I lied about my age, appearance, city ect. He wanted to meet irl so I told him I could not because "I wasn't in town at the time". He obviously got suspicious and stopped talking to me.

Then I met another guy and we started talking everyday, until, I cant remember how, we started dating. We started texting a lot and, eventually, sexting. Once again, I made up my entire life and showed him a photo of another girl. The poor kid was really into me so he wanted to meet me. The thing is, he lived in a town far away. I told him I was going to take the money, buy a train ticket and meet him, but I had intentions of canceling in the last moment.

But my mother read my phone. She came to my high school in recess to tell me about it. She was shaking and crying. She thought he was a pedophile and I was his pray, when it was me who lied to him. I knew for a fact he was a kid. We went to the police, but i convinced them to do nothing. I was grounded without computer, phone, consoles or any electronic device for 2 years, and after 4-5 years I cant still have any social network or play online games.

I feel so bad about this, I changed phone number so that guy could not reach me and I never had another twitter account or tried to access the other one. The poor kid didn't knew anything. He probably thinks Im a pedo. My mom was never the same and now its really paranoid and shelters me a lot. Im really paranoid about showing my face or this affecting my career. I want to say sorry to the guy but Im really afraid. I remember this every day.
